svg.title: Stem cell
svg.desc: Slender crypt-base columnar stem cell wedged between Paneth cells with basal nucleus and scant cytoplasm. Biological basis: LGR5-positive crypt-base columnar stem cells alternate with Paneth cells and continuously generate the intestinal epithelial lineages.
